description: The 1D heat equation of heat1d_model.py, calibrated in steps: the boundary temperature u_D is set by hand, k is fitted with u_D held there (and its posterior sampled by MCMC), then k and u_D are refined together with k's posterior as the prior. The merged values go back to heat1d_model.py as heat1d_calibrated_parameters.json.

steps.description: The boundary temperature is measured, so it is set rather than fitted.
The conductivity k, with u_D held at the measured boundary temperature.
k and u_D together, with fit-k's posterior of k as its prior.
